name: Go-Worship
shortDescription: UK mobile app for finding church events, sharing event information and supporting ticket booking.
suitableContexts: Churches promoting events to people seeking local worship gatherings
Attenders wanting to discover church events while travelling or at home
Organisers exploring an attendee-facing event-discovery channel

pricing.summary: The public App Store listing presents Go-Worship as a free download. The public material reviewed did not set out organiser listing, ticketing or payment fees.

gdprInformation: Go-Worship publishes website terms that refer to a privacy statement and cookie policy. Churches considering an organiser relationship should obtain the current privacy, event-listing and payment terms that apply to their specific use.
coreFeatures: Bible section in the mobile app
support: Published contact email and mobile-app support route

uk-operator.value: Go-Worship Ltd is a UK company and the mobile-app listing provides a London contact address for the developer.

product-availability.value: The App Store describes current event discovery and ticket-booking features, with an April 2026 update recorded.

terms.value: Supplier publishes website terms identifying Go Worship Ltd and UK jurisdiction.

editorial.assessment: Go-Worship is an attendee-facing discovery app for church events, rather than a full church database or venue ticketing back office. It may be useful as an additional discovery route for churches holding public events. It should be evaluated separately from systems that manage event registrations, safeguarding information or financial reconciliation.
bestFor: Churches seeking another channel to publicise open events
People discovering worship gatherings and events by place or preference
Organisers that want to assess an app-based ticket-booking and discovery option
strengths: Active UK operator and current mobile-app listing
Church-event discovery and sharing are central to the product
The app listing describes ticket-booking functionality
limitations: It is not a church-management or full event-operations platform
Public organiser pricing and payment terms were not available in the material reviewed
Confirm event publishing, ticketing, payment, support and data terms directly before relying on it for an event

procurementVerdict.problem: Making public church events easier for new people to discover
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK mobile app focused on church-event discovery rather than only a church's own audience
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask for current organiser listing and ticketing terms, then publish and test one representative public event

seo.title: Go-Worship review for UK churches
seo.description: Independent Go-Worship profile for UK churches: church-event discovery, ticket booking, mobile app and organiser checks.
